OfficeCategory.OFFICE_CATEGORY_DESCRIPTION: Voters of a county elect the county coroner, a constitutional officer, to a four-year term. The coroner is prohibited from serving more than two terms in a period of 12 years, except for time filling an unexpired term. The chief responsibility of the coroner is to determine the manner of death in cases involving violence or casualty, or when someone is found dead in unexplained circumstances.
